= Statement of Work: Management Cluster Bootstrap (Pulumi Stage A)
:author: AI Assistant + Human Collaborator
:revdate: 2026-03-05
:toc: left
:toclevels: 3
:icons: font

== Context

This SOW captures the *current execution plan* for starting implementation of the superseding provisioning strategy in:

* link:../../docs/cluster-provisioning-control-plane-v2.adoc[Cluster Provisioning Control Plane v2 (Superseding Plan)]

Immediate focus is *Stage A* only:

* bootstrap management control-plane seed from outside the cluster
* Pulumi (Java) based execution
* one-shot bootstrap with explicit handoff contract to Stage B

== Objectives

. Create and initialize the `rke2lab-bootstrap` repository as the Stage A implementation home
. Scaffold a Pulumi Java bootstrap app for management-cluster seed lifecycle
. Implement bootstrap outputs contract (`kubeconfig`, endpoint, node metadata)
. Establish runbook and break-glass baseline for repeatable operator execution
. Keep Stage B (CAPI/CAPRKE2/CAPN) and Phase 2 GitOps flow out of Stage A implementation scope

== Scope

=== In Scope

* New repository setup: `nxmatic/rke2lab-bootstrap`
* Local split git layout alignment:
** bare repo: `/var/lib/git/.bare/nxmatic/rke2lab-bootstrap.git`
** worktree: `/var/lib/git/nxmatic/rke2lab-bootstrap`
* Pulumi Java project bootstrap structure
* Stage A execution contract and outputs
* Initial operator runbook and validation checklist

=== Out of Scope

* In-cluster provisioning controllers (Stage B)
* Cluster API provider PoC implementation
* Full GitOps orchestration rollout (Flux/Porch/Tekton automation)
* Migration of existing rke2lab Make orchestration

== Deliverables

. `rke2lab-bootstrap` repository initialized and accessible
. Pulumi Java scaffold with baseline project files
. Stage A bootstrap command path documented
. Outputs contract documented (machine-readable + human-readable)
. Break-glass and rollback notes documented

== Acceptance Criteria

✅ *Repository and layout*

* [x] Remote repository exists on GitHub (`nxmatic/rke2lab-bootstrap`)
* [x] Local split bare/worktree layout is operational
* [x] `gh get` supports split-mode cloning for this workflow

⬜ *Bootstrap scaffold*

* [ ] Pulumi Java project skeleton committed in `rke2lab-bootstrap`
* [ ] Build/bootstrap commands execute without unresolved dependencies
* [ ] Initial stack config path defined for local NixOS VM execution

⬜ *Contract and runbook*

* [ ] Stage A outputs are explicitly documented
* [ ] Operator runbook includes prerequisites, run, verify, rollback
* [ ] Break-glass recovery path is documented for degraded management plane

== Execution Notes (Next Session)

. Initialize Pulumi Java project in `rke2lab-bootstrap`
. Add baseline config loader + output exporter stubs
. Implement bootstrap orchestration shell (provision + readiness wait + export)
. Record first runnable developer flow in README

== Risks and Controls

* *Risk*: Scope drift into Stage B during Stage A coding
** *Control*: enforce Stage A-only PR boundaries and SOW checklists

* *Risk*: runtime mismatch between Darwin host and NixOS VM tools
** *Control*: keep execution contract explicit and environment assumptions documented

* *Risk*: unclear ownership of bootstrap outputs
** *Control*: define output schema early and gate implementation on it
